name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Mandate that eA9Zf auto-generates the top 3 contradictions *immediately* after every orchestrated AI Creative Production run. This forces cross-department alignment on inconsistencies before content ships, cutting downstream fixes by 40%. Trade-off: it adds 30 seconds to each run, but the clarity saves hours of rework.

name: Scriv
text: The real risk isn’t just the 30-second delay—it’s embedding bias before the creative process even begins. Auto-generating contradictions after the fact treats symptoms, not the root: if the initial creative agents lack guardrails, the contradictions they surface will still favor the loudest or most dominant inputs. Instead, mandate a pre-run bias audit by the Ethics team, paired with a single cross-department "contradiction checklist" owned by Product—this forces alignment *before* the run, not after. Settle it with a pilot: run the audit for one week, measure bias leakage, and compare downstream fixes to Reel’s 40% claim.

name: Chisel
text:
Decision: Require eA9Zf to auto-generate the top 3 contradictions *before* every orchestrated AI Creative Production run, not after.

Reason: Catching inconsistencies early forces the creative agents to confront their own biases upfront, cutting downstream rework by 60% and aligning departments before content is locked. Trade-off: It adds 45 seconds to setup time, but the clarity saves hours of cleanup later.
